channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Ex-Lions Coach Battling Cancer Makes Emotional Return for Super Bowl LX
item.description: Former Detroit Lions coach Terrell Williams will be on the sidelines at Super Bowl LX with the New England Patriots after stepping away earlier this season to battle prostate cancer.

item.title: 3 Edge Rushers Detroit Lions MUST Consider in 2026 NFL Draft
item.description: The Detroit Lions need a true edge rusher opposite Aidan Hutchinson. Here are three EDGE prospects Detroit must consider with the No. 17 pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.

item.title: Minnesota Vikings Bold Move Sends Shockwaves Through NFL
item.description: The Minnesota Vikings stunned the NFL by firing GM Kwesi Adofo-Mensah just months after extending him and days after he attended the Senior Bowl.

item.title: NFL Insider Predicts Jahmyr Gibbs Contract Extension With Detroit Lions
item.description: ESPN’s Dan Graziano predicts Jahmyr Gibbs could sign a four-year, $80 million extension with the Detroit Lions as the team navigates the evolving running back market.

item.title: NFL Insider Predicts Jack Campbell Contract Extension Details With the Detroit Lions
item.description: An NFL insider predicts the Detroit Lions will extend linebacker Jack Campbell after his breakout season. Here’s the projected contract, salary range, and timing.

item.title: NFL Insider Reveals Massive 2026 NFL Salary Cap Projection
item.description: NFL insider Tom Pelissero reports the 2026 salary cap could exceed $300 million per team, signaling another massive financial leap for the league.

item.title: Red Wings HC Todd McLellan Sends Clear Message to Steve Yzerman Ahead of NHL Trade Deadline
item.description: Detroit Red Wings head coach Todd McLellan made it clear where the team stands as the trade deadline approaches, effectively sending a message to GM Steve Yzerman with Detroit firmly in the Eastern Conference playoff race.

item.title: Detroit Lions’ Amon-Ra St. Brown to Compete in NBA All-Star Event
item.description: Detroit Lions star Amon-Ra St. Brown will play in the NBA All-Star Celebrity Game. The Pro Bowl WR also played basketball in high school.

item.title: Dan Campbell Attends Michigan State Game as Spartans Fans Show the Love
item.description: Detroit Lions head coach Dan Campbell attended the Michigan State vs. Michigan basketball game at the Breslin Center, drawing a huge ovation from Spartans fans while wearing MSU gear.

item.title: Michigan Basketball DOMINATES Michigan State In 1st Half
item.description: Michigan basketball overwhelmed Michigan State in the first half, taking a 42–26 lead behind strong shooting, defense, and freshman Yaxel Lendeborg.
